## Final handoff status

Both [CI jobs](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/IPTFantasyFootball/actions/runs/42528759202) completed successfully for `d4adee3ba31376ab4af6704ca67cea4d1646daa3`. The unchanged native `MergeReadinessPolicyEngine`, using real GitHub PR/check adapters and persisted native review evidence, returned `{ "taskId": "MIG-001", "pullRequestNumber": 83, "ready": true, "reasons": [] }` for that same revision. GitHub reports `mergeable: true`, `draft: false`; there are no submitted blocking GitHub reviews or unresolved review threads. Main branch protection/rules are not configured; required repository checks were explicitly verified rather than assumed from GitHub settings.

**Ready for the owner's merge. Not merged; #80 remains open.** No merge-controller completion evidence or native DONE is asserted.

MIG-001 makes the migration's operating authority and admission process explicit. Closed bootstrap issues no longer imply cutover, and all 14 roadmap tasks now have schema-valid staged definitions, requirements, exact repository/branch mappings and audited prerequisite ownership.

Closes #80. Coordinates [migration epic #74](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/IPTFantasyFootball/issues/74), [Vibez roadmap #1](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/Vibez/issues/1), and bootstrap #1.

## Changes and acceptance evidence

| Criterion | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-01: authority mismatch | Root guidance and `migration/README.md` record #37's closed status, PR #79's prerequisite-only scope, and the specific remaining #37/#1 cutover decision. |
| AC-02: safe registration | 14 staged `ipt.task@1.0.0` and `ipt.requirement@1.0.0` records, full issue snapshots/body hashes, plan graph and admission owners. Native registry/DAG validation rejects invalid/missing/cyclic inputs; unresolved external work stays outside the active queue. |
| AC-03: empty-repository protocol | `migration/SEED.md` specifies the reviewed empty integration anchor, MIG-002/003 pre-native boundaries, independent reviews/exact-head CI, engine pin and switch to normal execution before MIG-004. No Vibez seed is performed here. |
| AC-04: real feature delivery | Scoped native MIG-001 start, six persisted validation records, three separate agent reviews ingested through unchanged native gates, and canonical PR publication through BOOT-022. |
| AC-05: retained canary | No changes to canary definition, driver, retirement record, engine source, runtime schemas or contracts. Dedicated MIG-001 state only; no historical canary run copied, resumed or edited. |

The source-delta ledger preserves #78's sole manual-driver ownership and records #76 fix integration as unresolved rather than inferring it from issue closure.

## Validation at `d4adee3ba31376ab4af6704ca67cea4d1646daa3`

- `npm run build`, `npm test`: PASS; 865 tests, zero failures.
- `python schemas/validate_fixtures.py`: PASS.
- `python schemas/validate_repository_contracts.py`: PASS, 58 authored records.
- `npm run migration:check`: PASS; all 14 templates remain staged/ineligible.
- `npm run test:adversarial:mutations`: PASS (the native gate runs the built mutation script after its build).
- QA independently ran nine focused tests and ten additional negative probes, verified zero writes on rejection and compared all 18 snapshots to GitHub.
- Local toolchain: Windows, Node 24.18.0, Python 3.14.6. [CI](https://github.com/Brain-Crumbs/IPTFantasyFootball/actions/runs/42528759202) independently checks the exact head with Node 20/Python 3.11 on Linux.
- `git diff --check`: PASS. Current main remains `fbc46888ce0bd2af454f471561911a913d32e6fc`.

## Independent review and native evidence

| architecture | `MIG-001::role::Architect` | 1 | PASS |
| uat | `MIG-001::role::UAT/Product` | 1 | PASS |

All three review IDs use `MIG-001:<role>:<head>:mig001-<agent-role>-<head>`; exact IDs and context/report hashes are retained below. Native state is **MERGE_READY**, not MERGED/DONE. MergeController evidence is intentionally absent because the user requested a PR handoff and prohibited merging.

Actual start: owner `mig001-developer`, run `mig001-20261108`, lock `dev-start:MIG-001:mig001-developer:mig001-20261108`, registration source `dfd4d4a295bfa77a68b7d531347e0335ad31048e`. Registration preparation preceded native start, as documented.

## Compatibility, limits and rollback

No engine API, schema identity, runtime format, selection policy or lifecycle rule changes. The current engine is pinned to FF `fbc46888ce0bd2af454f471561911a913d32e6fc` / private package 0.1.0. Its supported UAT context-source injection supplies Developer artifacts while the unchanged compiler preserves UAT visibility; this is not a claim that #76's repair landed.

External admission remains an explicit reviewed gate, not a new publication engine. #37/#1 own full cutover; #78 owns the general driver. No package release, destination code export, source deletion or historical completion is performed. The unavailable external live-canary store has no claimed before/after hash; unchanged tracked assets and isolated execution are the verified boundary.

Rollback reverts only the new registration/checker/guidance after stopping MIG-001 writers. Preserve its append-only state/evidence and all historical records; never delete journals or fabricate DONE. Both required CI jobs and live PR readiness still gate merge.
